title: Choreo Autonomous
description: Draw two paths in Choreo, then build an autonomous routine that drives them with a provided path follower: drive to the game piece, pick it up, drive to the scoring spot and shoot.

checkpoints.title: Reaches the pickup
checkpoints.description: Run Pickup And Score. The robot should get within 0.3 meters of the Pickup point.

checkpoints.title: Reaches the scoring spot
checkpoints.description: Run Pickup And Score. The robot should get within 0.3 meters of the ScoreSpot point.

checkpoints.title: Shoots
checkpoints.description: The routine should end by shooting at least once.

checkpoints.title: Shoots from the scoring spot
checkpoints.description: Every shot should be taken within 0.3 meters of the ScoreSpot point.
